angular.note: The host element is the root. title, emptyTitle, emptyBody and an item's title and body take a string or a TemplateRef. onMarkAllRead is a function input: the mark-all Button renders only with a handler while an item is unread, and focus moves to the title first. Ids come from the CDK id generator, one per item id. time.ts is a copy of the React helper until it moves to packages/shared. NotificationCenter.css is used as is.

native.note: A SectionList with a header per group; items as pressable rows.

styles.studio: Tokens only: no surface of its own, hairline separators, unread rows on overlay-5.
styles.desk: Tokens only; the unread dot takes the yellow primary border.
styles.neutral: Tokens only.

mistakes.wrong: The panel announcing each new item through a live region
mistakes.right: Announce once through toast(); the panel only lists

mistakes.wrong: Unread shown only by a tinted row
mistakes.right: The dot, the bold title and the hidden word come with unread

mistakes.wrong: Wrapping the panel in its own overlay
mistakes.right: Put it in a Popover from a bell IconButton, or a Sheet on phones

mistakes.wrong: Times written as 2026-11-12T14:55
mistakes.right: Pass the time; it renders 5 minutes ago with the ISO time in datetime

name: NumberField
summary: A number in a bordered box with a decrement and an increment button, locale formatting with Western digits, units and bounds.
useWhen: A count or an amount someone types or nudges: seats, guests, a quantity in a cart
A number with bounds and a step, where the step buttons and the arrow keys help
A money amount, a percent or a measure formatted for the locale (SAR, 15%, 2.5 kg)
avoidWhen: A Studio inspector value someone drags to change (width, rotation, opacity)
A rough value picked on a range, where the exact number matters less
A number that is an identifier and never counted: a phone number, a code, a card number

value.description: The value, controlled. null is an empty field.

defaultValue.description: The first value, uncontrolled. Default empty.

onChange.description: Called with the committed value after a step, on blur and on Enter. null when emptied.

min.description: The lowest value. Home goes to it. The decrement button disables at it.

max.description: The highest value. End goes to it. The increment button disables at it.

step.description: One step of the arrow keys and the buttons. PageUp and PageDown move ten steps. When set, a typed value snaps to it on commit.

formatOptions.description: Intl.NumberFormat options: decimals, percent, currency, unit. Digits stay Western unless numberingSystem is set.

locale.description: The locale of the format. Default the language of the nearest Theme, with Western digits (ar-u-nu-latn).

size.description: Height from size.control: 24, 28, 32 and 44 px at default density. The steppers are 24px, and 32px at lg.

shape.description: default takes radius.control from the style. pill is always fully round, with round steppers.

invalid.description: Marks the value invalid. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

disabled.description: Native disabled on the input. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

readOnly.description: Readable and focusable, the steppers hide. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

required.description: Sets aria-required, never native required. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

steppers.description: Shows the decrement and increment buttons.

incrementLabel.description: The accessible name of the increment button. Default Increase and the field name, in the locale.

decrementLabel.description: The accessible name of the decrement button. Default Decrease and the field name, in the locale.

start.description: An icon name, a short text or a node. Icon names and texts are aria-hidden.

end.description: A unit such as px, an icon name or a node. Icon names and texts are aria-hidden: say the unit in the label or use formatOptions.

rootProps.description: Props for the root box. className and style also go to the root; the ref and native input props go to the input.

a11y.role: textbox with aria-roledescription number field, from React Aria. The steppers are buttons with aria-controls on the input.
a11y.focus: The input is the only tab stop. The steppers are out of the tab order and do not take focus on press. Clicking the box outside the steppers focuses the input. Focus shows the glow and a 2px ring around the box.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the input, and on to the next control
keys.Enter: Commits the typed value and formats it

a11y.announce: Name from the Field label or aria-label. A committed value that changes the text is announced. Each stepper is named Increase or Decrease and the field name. The Field description and error through aria-describedby.
notes: Typing allows Western and Arabic Indic digits and the Arabic decimal and thousands marks. They become Western as they are typed or pasted, so the value never jumps on blur.
The value runs left to right in tabular figures, on the reading side of the form.
A typed value that is not a number goes back to the last value on blur.
The mouse wheel never changes the value, so a page scroll over the field is safe.
A caller's onKeyDown does not receive PageUp and PageDown; the field handles them.
No native title attribute. Use the Field description for the bounds.

en.label: A noun in sentence case that says what is counted: Seats, Guests, Width.
en.placeholder: An example at most: For example, 12. Never the bounds; put them in the description.
en.description: The bounds and the step when they are not obvious: Between 1 and 50.
en.error: What to type: Enter a number from 1 to 50.

ar.label: اسم للشي المعدود بدون تشكيل: عدد المقاعد، الكمية، العرض
ar.digits: الأرقام غربية دايم، والأرقام العربية مقبولة وقت الكتابة
ar.error: قل وش يكتب: اكتب رقم من 1 إلى 50

react.behavior: react-aria-components NumberField, rendered with our elements through its render prop
react.note: Motion: fade. Only the focus glow fades (an opacity transition), and the value changes at once: number-roll is for a value someone reads, not one they type.

angular.behavior: div[dsNumberField] with a native input and two dsIconButton steppers, hand built on packages/shared number.ts with React Aria's rules, CDK LiveAnnouncer, ControlValueAccessor
angular.note: Same DOM, keys and words as React (React Aria's English and Arabic stepper names and role description). value is a model: [(value)]; defaultValue is value and onChange is valueChange, fired with each committed change. start and end take an icon name, a short text or a TemplateRef. rootProps, className and style have no input: attributes on the host already land on the root. The hidden input named name sits after the root, as in React. Stepper words exist in English and Arabic only. The mouse wheel never changes the value.

styles.studio: The Input pill with round ghost steppers at the two ends, the glow and the 2px ring on focus
styles.desk: The same box and steppers, in Instrument Sans

mistakes.wrong: Input type number for a count with bounds
mistakes.right: NumberField, which formats, steps, clamps and keeps Western digits

mistakes.wrong: NumberField for a phone number or a code
mistakes.right: PhoneField or OTPField

mistakes.wrong: The unit only in the end adornment, so a screen reader hears a bare number
mistakes.right: The unit in the label (Width, px) or formatOptions with style unit

mistakes.wrong: Arabic Indic digits in the shown value under Arabic
mistakes.right: Western digits; Arabic Indic digits are accepted on input

mistakes.wrong: Stacked chevron steppers inside a 32px box
mistakes.right: The two 24px steppers at the ends, so each is a full target

name: OTPField
summary: A one time code shown in separate cells: one native input holds the code, the cells draw it.
useWhen: A verification code sent by text message or email, usually 4 to 8 digits
A pairing code shown on another device
A backup code of letters and digits with a fixed length
avoidWhen: A password or a passphrase the person made up
A value with no fixed length, such as an amount or an order number
A phone number, a card number or a date

length.description: Number of cells and characters in a full code.

groups.description: Group sizes, for a separator between groups: [3, 3] shows 123 456. Ignored when they do not add up to length.

charset.description: numeric: digits and the number keypad. alphanumeric: Latin letters, upper cased, and digits.

value.description: The code, controlled.

defaultValue.description: The first code, uncontrolled.

onValueChange.description: Called with the parsed code each time it changes.

onComplete.description: Called each time the code becomes a new full code: the last cell typed, a paste, an autofill, or one cell of a full code changed.

size.description: Cell height and width from size.control: 24, 28, 32 and 44 px at default density.

shape.description: default takes radius.field from the style. pill draws round cells.

invalid.description: Marks the code invalid. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

disabled.description: Native disabled on the input. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

readOnly.description: Still focusable and readable. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

required.description: Sets aria-required. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

autoComplete.description: Lets the SMS autofill of iOS and Android and password managers fill the code.

rootProps.description: Props for the root. className and style also go to the root; every other native prop and the ref go to the input.

a11y.role: textbox, from the one native input. The cells and separators are aria-hidden drawings of its value.
a11y.focus: The input is the only tab stop. Tab lands on the first empty cell, or the last cell of a full code. A click picks the cell under the pointer. The active cell shows the glow and a 2px ring.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the code, and on to the next control
keys.ArrowLeft, ArrowRight: Move one cell back or on. The cells run left to right in every language, so ArrowLeft is always the previous cell: inside the left to right group the physical direction is the reading direction
keys.Home, End: Move to the first cell, or to the first empty cell
keys.Shift+ArrowLeft, Shift+ArrowRight: Extend the selection over several cells, as in any text field
keys.Backspace: Clears the active cell, the cells after it move back one place, and the cell before it becomes active
keys.Delete: Clears the active cell; the cells after it move back

a11y.announce: One name for the whole code, from the Field label or aria-label. The Field description and error through aria-describedby. The value reads as the code.
notes: One input, not one per cell: the SMS autofill of iOS and Android and password managers fill one field with the whole code, a paste lands in one field, and a screen reader meets one named field instead of six unnamed boxes. This keeps paste and autofill working (WCAG 2.2, 3.3.8 accessible authentication).
Paste is never blocked. A paste replaces the whole code. Spaces, dashes and Arabic Indic digits are read, and the one code in a pasted SMS sentence is found (parseCode in @the-system/shared).
autocomplete one-time-code and inputmode numeric are set; the number keypad opens on phones. The input uses a 16px font, so phones do not zoom on focus.
No maxlength: a pasted code with spaces would be cut before it is read. The code is cut to length after it is read.
The root has dir ltr: a code reads left to right in Arabic too, like a phone number.
Check the code when onComplete fires, and say the result in the Field error or description. Never clear the code on an error: the person may want to fix one digit.
Do not put a time limit on entry without a way to ask for a new code (WCAG 2.2.1).

en.label: A noun in sentence case: Verification code, Pairing code, Backup code. One label for the whole field.
en.description: Where the code was sent, and how long it lasts: We sent a 6 digit code to the number ending in 1234.
en.error: What happened and what to do: This code has expired. Send a new code and enter it here.

ar.label: رمز التحقق، رمز الربط، الرمز الاحتياطي
ar.description: وين وصل الرمز وكم مدته، بالأرقام اللاتينية
ar.error: وش صار ووش يسوي: الرمز انتهت صلاحيته، اطلب رمز جديد

angular.behavior: div[dsOTPField] around one native input, hand built on packages/shared otp.ts, ControlValueAccessor
angular.note: Same DOM and keys as React: one input with autocomplete one-time-code over aria-hidden cells. value is a model (defaultValue is value); onComplete is the complete output. The input shows the parsed code at once, so a refused key leaves no trace. The React gallery routes it at /c/otpfield, the contract and the Angular gallery at /c/otp-field (see the lane report).

styles.studio: Square cells with the field radius and the control border; the active cell takes the soft glow and the 2px achromatic ring
styles.desk: The same cells and ring, digits in Instrument Sans with tabular figures

mistakes.wrong: Six separate inputs, one per digit
mistakes.right: One OTPField: autofill, paste and screen readers see one field

mistakes.wrong: Blocking paste or autofill on the code
mistakes.right: Leave both on; OTPField reads spaces, dashes and SMS text

name: PageShell
summary: The frame of a page: a skip link first, then a header, the navigation column, one main, an aside and a footer, each in its landmark. Under breakpoint.tablet the navigation moves to a Drawer behind a menu button.
useWhen: The outer frame of an app or a site page, once per page
A page with a side navigation (Sidebar or Rail) that must fold away on phones
Any page that needs the landmarks and the skip link set up the same way everywhere
avoidWhen: A part of a page: a card, a panel or a form section
A second frame inside a page that already has one, except as a preview with embedded
Side by side list and detail inside main

parts.Drawer: the navigation on narrow screens and while the column is hidden (outside the root, in a portal)

header.description: The top bar: a Navbar, or a brand and actions. In the header landmark (banner).

nav.description: A Sidebar or a Rail, each its own labelled nav landmark. The nav part is a plain element around it.

aside.description: Secondary content next to main. Under breakpoint.desktop it goes under main.

asideLabel.description: The name of the aside landmark. Arabic default: تفاصيل إضافية.

children.description: The page content, in main.

mainId.description: The id of main and the skip link target. One per page.

skipLabel.description: The skip link text. Arabic default from SkipLink: الانتقال للمحتوى الرئيسي.

sidebar.description: The column state on wide screens, controlled, with onSidebarChange. Under breakpoint.tablet the root always says hidden.

menuLabel.description: The menu button's name. Arabic default: فتح التنقل.

drawerTitle.description: The title of the navigation Drawer. Arabic default: التنقل.

embedded.description: A preview of a page inside another page (a gallery, docs, a template picker): the same frame with no landmarks; main becomes a region named Main content.

a11y.role: No role on the root. header is the banner, main the main landmark (one per page, id main), aside a complementary landmark with a label, footer the contentinfo. The navigation landmark is the Sidebar or Rail inside the nav part.
a11y.focus: The skip link is the first tab stop; Enter moves focus to main. The menu button opens the navigation Drawer, and focus returns to it when the Drawer closes.

keys.Tab: The first press reaches the skip link, then the menu button (only while the column is hidden), the header, the navigation, main, the aside and the footer in that order
keys.Shift+Tab: Moves back through the same order
keys.Enter: On the skip link, moves focus to main

a11y.announce: Landmarks carry the names a screen reader lists: the Sidebar or Rail label, the aside label.
notes: The reading order equals the visual order in every width: header, navigation, main, aside, footer.

Under breakpoint.tablet the column is not rendered, so its links are never in the page twice; the Drawer renders them while open. A media query hides the column from the first paint, before hydration.
A click on a link inside the navigation Drawer closes it, so a client routed page does not open under it.
While the column is hidden on a wide screen (sidebar hidden), the menu button and the Drawer are the way to the navigation, as on phones.
No motion: the column swaps at once. The Drawer brings its own motion (pattern sheet).
The shell takes the height of its parent (min-block-size 100%). Give html and body a height for a full screen frame; no viewport height token exists yet.
No native title attribute.

en.asideLabel: A noun phrase that names the content: Board details, Filters.
en.skipLabel: Skip to main content, or name the target: Skip to the board list.

react.note: Renders SkipLink, IconButton and Drawer. The hook usePageShell() shares the column state: { sidebar, wideSidebar, setSidebar, narrow, setDrawerOpen }. Pass collapsed={sidebar === 'collapsed'} and onCollapsedChange to the Sidebar so its toggle and the shell agree.

angular.behavior: cdk:layout BreakpointObserver
angular.note: Content projection into the same parts.

native.note: Native apps use navigation stacks and tab bars from the router, not a page frame with landmarks.

styles.studio: No recipe: the page color with 1px lines between the regions, the compact header at the large control height.
styles.desk: No recipe: the same frame on the Desk page color. Desk apps usually live in Windows, not in a PageShell.
styles.neutral: Tokens only: the Neutral page color and borders.
styles.liquid: Planned: the header and navigation may float on glass over scrolling content.

mistakes.wrong: Two PageShells on one page, or a PageShell inside main
mistakes.right: One per page; previews inside a page use embedded

mistakes.wrong: A nav element around the Sidebar
mistakes.right: Pass the Sidebar as nav: it is the labelled nav landmark itself

mistakes.wrong: Hiding the Sidebar on phones with display none and no other way in
mistakes.right: PageShell moves it to a Drawer behind the menu button

mistakes.wrong: A Sidebar with its own collapsed state that the shell does not know
mistakes.right: Wire collapsed and onCollapsedChange to usePageShell()

mistakes.wrong: A main id other than the skip link target
mistakes.right: mainId sets both

name: Pagination
summary: Page controls for a long list or table: first, previous, page numbers with ellipses, next and last, with an optional item summary such as 21 to 40 of 312.
useWhen: A list or table split into pages of a fixed size, where readers need to know where they are and jump to a page
Search results or an archive where a page number can be shared in a URL, with getHref
A data table footer that shows which rows are on screen, with itemCount and pageSize
avoidWhen: A feed read from top to bottom, where loading more on scroll or a Load more button fits better
Steps of a task done in order
Fewer items than one page holds, unless the summary is still useful
Moving between slides of a carousel

insteadUse.A feed that grows as the reader scrolls: Button with Load more items, or infinite loading

page.description: The current page, from 1. Controlled, with onPageChange. Clamped into 1 to the page count.

defaultPage.description: The first page shown when uncontrolled.

onPageChange.description: Called with the new page when a control is pressed. Not called for the current page.

pageCount.description: The number of pages. Default: worked out from itemCount and pageSize, else 1. A count under 1 or NaN reads as 1.

itemCount.description: The number of items in the list. Turns on the summary part. A count that is not a finite number (NaN, Infinity) shows no summary and counts as one page.

pageSize.description: Items per page, for the summary and the page count. A size under 1 or not a finite number reads as 20.

siblings.description: Pages shown on each side of the current page (pageRange in @the-system/shared).

boundaries.description: Pages always shown at each end.

showEnds.description: Shows the first and last page buttons.

getHref.description: Turns every control into a link (Button asChild with an a). Default none: buttons. A click with a modifier key or a middle click is left to the browser and does not change the page.

size.description: Control height, as Button: sm 28, md 32, lg 44 at default density.

shape.description: Corner shape of every control, as Button.

disabled.description: Every control is inert (aria-disabled, still focusable), for example while the list loads.

label.description: The accessible name of the nav landmark, not visible text. Under an Arabic Theme the default is التنقل بين الصفحات.

formatSummary.description: Replaces the summary text. Default 21 to 40 of 312, in Arabic 21 إلى 40 من 312. An empty list says No items, in Arabic ما فيه عناصر.

a11y.role: navigation landmark (nav with aria-label) of buttons, or links with getHref
a11y.focus: Every control is a tab stop in reading order. An end with nowhere to go stays focusable with aria-disabled, so focus is not lost on the first or last page; in link mode, where Button drops the href of an inert link, Pagination gives it tabIndex 0. Each page control is keyed by its number at one level of the list, so focus stays on the pressed page when the window of pages shifts (4 to 5, 250 to 251). A 2px ring from the Button focus tokens.

keys.Tab: Moves through the controls
keys.Enter: Goes to that page

a11y.announce: Each page reads as Page 5, the current one as Page 5, current page. The ends read First page, Previous page, Next page, Last page. Ellipses are aria-hidden. The summary is plain text before the controls.
notes: The current page has a border in color.text.muted (5.76:1 to 8.58:1 against the page across Studio, Desk and Neutral, dark and light; WCAG 1.4.11), a weight step from font.weight.regular to font.weight.bold (400 to 700, 400 to 600 in Neutral), a soft fill and aria-current page, never color alone (WCAG 1.4.1).
The ends use chevrons-back, chevron-back, chevron-forward and chevrons-forward, mirrored in RTL.
Numbers use Western digits in both languages, grouped with a comma (12,480).

Under breakpoint.phone (30rem) the compact form keeps the ends, the current page and the last page, with a compact-only ellipsis (data-compact) between them when pages are hidden; the summary takes its own line and wraps. No sideways scroll at 320px (WCAG 1.4.10).
The page row keeps the same length as the current page moves (pageRange), so controls do not jump under the pointer.
A page label Page 5 contains the visible number, so voice control by the number works (WCAG 2.5.3).
data-active and data-disabled sit on the child controls (page, and first, previous, next, last), not on the root. disabled makes every control aria-disabled.

en.summary: First to last item of the total: 21 to 40 of 312. Name the items in formatSummary when the page does not: 21 to 40 of 312 boards.
en.labels: Page 5, First page, Previous page, Next page, Last page. These are not a verb plus a noun: they are the standard names of pagination controls, an accepted exception to the button rule.

ar.summary: 21 إلى 40 من 312, Western digits. Empty list: ما فيه عناصر.
ar.labels: صفحة 5، الصفحة الأولى، الصفحة السابقة، الصفحة التالية، الصفحة الأخيرة. Noun form, no diacritics.

react.behavior: nav of system Button and IconButton (asChild links with getHref); pageRange and itemRange from @the-system/shared
react.note: The only motion is the Button press, reduced to none under reduced motion. Round 2 (order 1.22, proposed), interaction pagination-roll: the current page holds an empty aria-hidden span (inside the page part) that draws its fill so the shared pill can slide it; page numbers sit in an aria-hidden span in the label (the page keeps its aria-label) and roll digit by digit with rollDigits when the window shifts; a pressed arrow winds up (back by distance.nudge, forward by distance.shift).

angular.behavior: nav[dsPagination] with button[dsButton] or a[dsButton] controls and the shared pageRange

native.note: A row of Pressables with accessibilityState selected on the current page; the compact form on phones.

styles.studio: Ghost page buttons at regular weight, the current page bold with a soft fill and a muted text color border, pixel chevrons on the ends.
styles.desk: The same from the Desk tokens: pill controls, the current page bordered.
styles.neutral: Takes the tokens of the Neutral style, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: The current page told apart by color only
mistakes.right: Pagination, which adds a 3:1 border, a weight step and aria-current page

mistakes.wrong: Previous and next removed on the first and last page, so focus is lost
mistakes.right: Pagination, which keeps them focusable with aria-disabled

mistakes.wrong: A row of every page number for 500 pages
mistakes.right: Pagination, which shows boundaries, siblings and ellipses

mistakes.wrong: Arrow characters typed as previous and next labels
mistakes.right: The mirrored chevron icons with spoken labels

mistakes.wrong: Eastern Arabic digits in the page numbers
mistakes.right: Western digits, the default in both languages

name: PasswordField
summary: A password input with a show and hide toggle, built on Input, that works with password managers.
useWhen: Signing in with a password
Setting or changing a password, with autoComplete new-password
A secret the person may need to check by eye: a recovery phrase, an API key shown read only
avoidWhen: A one time code sent by text or email
A PIN of a few digits in separate boxes
A value that is not secret

insteadUse.A secret with a copy button: InputGroup with a PasswordField and an IconButton

size.description: Height from size.control: 24, 28, 32 and 44 px at default density. The toggle is xs, and sm at lg.

shape.description: default takes radius.control from the style, a pill in Studio and Desk. pill is always fully round.

visible.description: The value shows as plain text, controlled. Pair it with onVisibleChange.

defaultVisible.description: The value shows as plain text at first, uncontrolled.

onVisibleChange.description: Called when the toggle shows or hides the value, and with false when the form around it submits.

showLabel.description: The toggle's name while the value is hidden.

hideLabel.description: The toggle's name while the value shows.

autoComplete.description: Passed to the input so password managers fill and suggest (WCAG 3.3.8). new-password when setting one.

invalid.description: Inside a Field it follows the Field.

disabled.description: Native disabled on the input; the toggle keeps aria-disabled and stays focusable. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

readOnly.description: Inside a Field it follows the Field. The toggle still shows and hides the value.

rootProps.description: Props for the root box. className and style also go to the root; every other native prop and the ref go to the input.

a11y.role: textbox for the native input (type password while hidden, type text while shown); the toggle is a button with aria-pressed and aria-controls pointing at the input
a11y.focus: Tab reaches the input, then the toggle. A press keeps focus on the toggle. Clicking the box outside the toggle focuses the input.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the input, then to the toggle
keys.Enter: On the toggle: shows or hides the value; focus stays on the toggle
keys.Space: On the toggle: shows or hides the value; focus stays on the toggle

a11y.announce: Name from the Field label. The toggle is announced as Show password, toggle button, not pressed; after a press, Hide password, pressed. The name changes as well as the state, as the order asks, so the name always says what a press does.
notes: Paste is never blocked and autoComplete passes through, so password managers work (WCAG 3.3.8, accessible authentication).
The value hides again when the form around it submits, so it is not left on screen.
Spell check, autocorrect and autocapitalize are off, so the shown value is not changed or sent to a spell service.
Hand built: the Radix password toggle field is exported as unstable_, so it is not used.
Edge's own reveal button is hidden, so only one toggle shows. The value hides on the form's submit event; a script that calls form.submit() skips that event, so hide it yourself there.

en.label: Password, Current password, New password.
en.description: Say the rule before the person types: At least 12 characters. Never a list of symbol rules.
en.error: Say how to fix it: Use at least 12 characters.
en.toggle: Show password, Hide password. Show key, Hide key for an API key.

ar.label: كلمة المرور، كلمة المرور الحالية، كلمة المرور الجديدة
ar.toggle: إظهار كلمة المرور، إخفاء كلمة المرور

react.behavior: hand built on Input, IconButton toggle with aria-pressed
react.note: Motion: only the focus glow fades in, as on Input; the value swap is instant. The root is the bordered box; the nested Input is the control part.

angular.behavior: div[dsPasswordField] on dsInput and dsIconButton, aria-pressed toggle, ControlValueAccessor
angular.note: The root is the bordered box; the nested dsInput is the control part. visible and defaultVisible are the visible model ([(visible)]), onVisibleChange its visibleChange output; defaultValue is value. The value hides again on form submit: the input turns password before the browser reads the form.

styles.studio: The Input look: a bordered transparent pill, the soft glow and the 2px ring on focus, a ghost eye toggle at the end.
styles.desk: The same pill and glow, in Instrument Sans.
styles.neutral: Takes the tokens of the Neutral style, no recipe.

mistakes.wrong: onPaste that calls preventDefault to stop pasting
mistakes.right: Allow paste, so password managers and people with motor needs can fill it

mistakes.wrong: autoComplete off on a sign in password
mistakes.right: current-password to sign in, new-password to set one

mistakes.wrong: An Input with type password and a separate Button that changes its type
mistakes.right: PasswordField, which keeps focus, names the toggle and hides the value on submit

mistakes.wrong: The value left shown after the form is sent
mistakes.right: PasswordField hides it again on submit

name: PhoneField
summary: A phone number with a country code picker, Gulf countries first. The value out is E.164.
useWhen: A mobile or landline number that may be outside the home country
A number you will send a text message or call to, and need in E.164 form
A sign up or checkout form for the Gulf, where most numbers are SA, AE, KW, QA, BH or OM
avoidWhen: A one time code sent to the phone
A number that is always local and stored as typed
A short internal extension

value.description: The number in E.164 form, +966501234567, controlled. An empty string clears it.

defaultValue.description: The first number in E.164 form, uncontrolled.

onValueChange.type: (value: string, detail: { country: string; national: string; valid: boolean }) => void
onValueChange.description: Called with the E.164 number (empty while there are no digits). valid is the length check for the country.

country.description: The selected country, an ISO 3166 code, controlled.

onCountryChange.description: Called when the country changes, from the picker or from a pasted +number.

countries.description: Limits the picker to these ISO codes. The Gulf countries in the list still come first.

locale.description: Language of the country names. Default: the lang of the nearest Theme.

labels.type: { country?: string; gulf?: string; all?: string }
labels.description: The picker's accessible name and its two group labels. English and Arabic defaults follow the language.

name.description: A hidden input with this name posts the E.164 number with the form.

size.description: Height from size.control: 24, 28, 32 and 44 px at default density.

shape.description: default takes radius.control from the style. pill is always fully round.

invalid.description: Marks the number invalid. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

disabled.description: Disables the picker and the number. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

readOnly.description: The number stays focusable and readable; the picker is not shown, only the dial code.

required.description: Sets aria-required on the number. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

rootProps.description: Props for the root box. className and style also go to the root; every other native prop and the ref go to the number input.

a11y.role: combobox for the native select (country), textbox for the native tel input (number)
a11y.focus: Two tab stops: the country picker, then the number. Focus on either shows the glow and the 2px ring around the box; the dial code also fills while the picker has focus.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the country picker, then to the number
keys.ArrowUp, ArrowDown: On the picker, choose the previous or the next country (native select)
keys.Enter, Space: On the picker, open the country list (native select, by platform)
keys.Home, End: On the number, move the caret to the start or the end

a11y.announce: The number takes its name from the Field label, the description and error through aria-describedby. The picker is named Country code plus the Field label (Country code, Mobile number) and reads the country name and its dial code. Read only, the number is described by its dial code.
notes: The country is a native select (decision 4 of wave 1): the platform picker on phones and type ahead on desktops. It covers the dial code and is transparent, so the closed state shows +966 and not a long country name.
The number always runs left to right (dir ltr on the input), also inside Arabic. The dial code is isolated in a bdi. In Arabic the dial code sits at the start (right) and the number next to it.
A pasted or autofilled +9665... or 009665... sets the country. Arabic Indic digits are read. The trunk 0 of SA and AE is dropped: 050 becomes 50.
Gulf numbers are grouped as typed (50 123 4567, 5000 1234) and checked for length. Other countries keep their digits as typed and get the E.164 limit only.

The value out is E.164 from onValueChange and the hidden input named name. Keep the last detail from onValueChange and check detail.valid on blur or on submit, never on every key. Changing the country keeps the digits; detail.valid says whether their length fits the new country.
Paste and autofill are never blocked (WCAG 2.2, 3.3.8).

en.label: A noun in sentence case: Mobile number, Office number. Never Phone # or Tel.
en.placeholder: The Gulf example comes by default: 50 123 4567. Never the label.
en.error: Say how many digits and give an example: Enter the 9 digits after +966, for example 50 123 4567.

ar.label: رقم الجوال، رقم المكتب
ar.error: وضح كم رقم ومثال: اكتب 9 أرقام بعد +966، مثل 50 123 4567

react.behavior: hand built on a native select and a native tel input

angular.behavior: div[dsPhoneField] with a native select and a native tel input, hand built on packages/shared phone.ts, ControlValueAccessor
angular.note: value (E.164) is a model: [(value)]. country is an input with a countryChange output, so [(country)] works and a set country wins over the dial code of the value, as in React; defaultCountry (default SA) is used while country is not set. onValueChange's detail is the valueDetail output. The caret stays after the same digit as the groups add spaces. The hidden input named name posts the E.164 number.

styles.studio: The Input pill with the dial code at the start behind a divider, the soft glow and the 2px achromatic ring on focus
styles.desk: The same box and ring, digits in Instrument Sans with tabular figures

mistakes.wrong: A custom dropdown for the country
mistakes.right: PhoneField's native select: the platform picker on phones and type ahead

mistakes.wrong: Storing the number as typed, 050 123 4567
mistakes.right: Store the E.164 value, +966501234567

mistakes.wrong: Blocking paste or stripping the plus
mistakes.right: Leave paste on; a pasted +number sets the country

mistakes.wrong: dir rtl on the number in an Arabic form
mistakes.right: PhoneField keeps the number left to right

mistakes.wrong: Checking the length on every key
mistakes.right: Keep the last detail from onValueChange and check detail.valid on blur or on submit

name: Popover
summary: Non modal content anchored to a trigger: a small form or details next to the control that opened it. The page stays usable while it is open.
useWhen: A small form of one to three fields tied to one control (rename, set a link, set a size)
Details about a control that need more than one line or hold a link or an action
Settings that apply to the selection and are changed while the page stays in view
avoidWhen: A one line hint for a control on hover and focus
A list of commands to pick from
A decision that blocks the page or must be answered
A preview of a link or a person that the user only reads
Long content or more than three fields

onOpenChange.description: Called with false for Escape, an outside click, the close control and PopoverClose.

size.description: The width: sm 240 (tooltip.width.max), md 320 (menu.width.min times 1.6), lg 440 px (dialog.width.md), never wider than the room beside the trigger.

side.description: PopoverContent: the preferred side. start and end follow the reading direction, so start is the right side in Arabic. It flips to the other side when there is no room.

align.description: PopoverContent: alignment along the trigger, mirrored in right to left layouts.

sideOffset.description: PopoverContent: distance from the trigger in px, the arrow included.

hideWhenDetached.description: PopoverContent: hides the popover while its trigger is scrolled out of view, for popovers in scrolling panels.

arrow.description: PopoverContent: shows the arrow that points at the trigger.

close.description: PopoverContent: shows the CloseButton. Escape and an outside click always close.

closeLabel.description: PopoverContent: accessible name of the close control. Arabic default under lang ar: إغلاق.

title.description: PopoverContent: the title for the common case, the same as a PopoverTitle child. It names the popover.

PopoverTrigger.description: One child element, a system Button or IconButton, rendered as the trigger (always asChild). It gets aria-haspopup dialog and aria-expanded and takes focus back on close.

PopoverClose.description: One child element, a system Button, that closes the popover (always asChild).

PopoverAnchor.description: Positions the popover against this element instead of the trigger.

data-autofocus.description: Put on any focusable element inside the popover to take focus on open.

a11y.role: dialog (the root), not modal: the page stays in the accessibility tree and usable. Named by the title (aria-labelledby); without a title pass aria-label on PopoverContent.
a11y.focus: On open, focus goes to an element marked data-autofocus; else to the first field in the body; else to the first footer action; else to the root itself. Never to the close control first. On close, focus returns to the trigger.

keys.Enter, Space: On the trigger: opens and closes the popover
keys.Escape: Closes the popover and returns focus to the trigger
keys.Tab: Moves to the next control inside the popover and wraps from the last to the first (the Radix focus scope loops). Not modal: Escape closes it and returns focus to the trigger, and a click outside closes it
keys.Shift+Tab: Moves to the previous control inside the popover and wraps from the first to the last

a11y.announce: The trigger says it opens a dialog and whether it is expanded. On open the title is read as the name of the dialog, then the focused field.
notes: Not modal: a click outside closes the popover and the page keeps working. Use Dialog for a decision that blocks the page.
The popover never runs past the viewport: it flips to the other side, shifts along the trigger, and its body scrolls inside the height left.
A popover opened from inside a Dialog sits above it (z.menu over z.dialog) and below the toasts.
The close control is the button path for Escape and the outside click. Hide it with close false only when a footer action closes the popover.
The arrow is decoration and hidden from assistive tech.
A disabled trigger is aria-disabled: it stays focusable and does not open.
No native title attribute.

The root also carries data-side and data-align from Radix. data-side is physical (top, right, bottom, left) after the logical side prop is mapped by direction: side start is data-side right in Arabic.
Focus returns to the trigger on close. A popover with only a PopoverAnchor returns focus to the element that had it when it opened.
Inside a scrolling panel pass hideWhenDetached so the popover hides while its trigger is scrolled out of view (default false).

Order 1.23 motion: the surface unfolds out of its trigger side, more along the axis away from the trigger (--_popover-enter-stretch) than across it. A part that holds focus runs its arrival in no time, so focus leaving it never replays the arrival.

en.title: A noun phrase for what is edited or shown, sentence case: Rename layer, Frame size, File details.
en.buttons: Verb plus noun: Rename layer, Apply size, Save link. Never OK, Yes, Continue or Confirm. The primary action last.

ar.title: Noun form, no diacritics: تسمية الطبقة، مقاس الإطار.
ar.buttons: Noun form labels: حفظ الاسم، إلغاء. Never نعم or موافق.

name: ProgressBar
summary: A labelled bar that shows how far a task has come, or that it runs with no known end.
useWhen: A task that reports how far it is: an upload, an export, an import
A task with no known end that takes more than a few seconds and has a name, as the indeterminate form
A list of tasks, one small bar per row
avoidWhen: A measured value that is not a task, such as storage used or a score
A short wait on a small area with no value
Little room, such as a card corner or a file chip
Steps the person moves through, such as a form wizard

value.description: Progress from 0 to max. null or undefined gives the indeterminate form. Values out of range are clamped.

max.description: The value that means done. The minimum is always 0 (Radix Progress).

label.description: Visible text that names the task and labels the progressbar through aria-labelledby. Without it, pass aria-label.

showValue.description: Shows the value text at the end of the label row: the percent, or the loading words while indeterminate.

valueText.description: (value, max) => string. Builds both the visible value and aria-valuetext, for example 3 of 10 files. Default: a whole percent in the page language with Western digits.

loadingLabel.description: What the value and aria-valuetext say while indeterminate. Arabic default under lang ar: جار التحميل.

size.description: Track thickness 4, 8 and 12 px (space.fixed.2xs, m, xl); the text steps from font.size.xs to m.

tone.description: Indicator color. accent is color.primary.on-surface; the others are color.state.<tone>.border, which holds 3:1 on the track in every style (WCAG 1.4.11).

a11y.role: progressbar (Radix Progress) with aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext
a11y.focus: Never focusable.
a11y.announce: Not a live region: a screen reader reads the label and the value text when it reaches the bar. aria-valuetext carries the formatted value, or the loading words while indeterminate. To announce a finish, say it once in a Toast or a status line.
notes: The label and the value sit inside the progressbar; its children are presentational, so the label names it through aria-labelledby and the value through aria-valuetext.

Indeterminate slides a 40% segment along the track. Under reduced motion it stops as a still segment in the middle of the track, in the full tone color: a shape no value can take. The value text says Loading.
The indicator scales from the inline start: it fills from the right in Arabic.
Under forced colors the track has a CanvasText border and the indicator is Highlight.
Tone is never the only signal: the label says what happened (Upload stopped) and the value says how far.
WCAG 2.2.2: the indeterminate loop has no pause control; a busy indicator is essential motion, and it stops under reduced motion.
The percent is rounded down, so an unfinished task never shows 100%.

With showValue false the indeterminate bar has no visible Loading text; the still middle segment under reduced motion still reads as busy, but keep showValue on or say the state in text next to the bar.

en.label: Name the task as a present participle plus a noun: Uploading files, Exporting board. On a stop, say what happened and what to do next.
en.value: A whole percent by default. Count units when they mean more: 3 of 10 files.
en.loading: Loading by default; a more exact verb when known: Preparing export.

ar.label: Noun form labels, no diacritics: رفع الملفات، تصدير اللوحة.

react.note: Value changes ease the scaleX transform over duration.slow. No catalog pattern: the indeterminate slide is a keyframe in ProgressBar.css until the catalog has a bar slide (a request to the motion owner). Values are formatted with Intl.NumberFormat and Western digits in a private helper (format.ts) until packages/shared/src/number.ts lands.

name: ProgressCircle
summary: Compact progress in a ring, for a file chip, a card corner or a table cell.
useWhen: Progress of a task in little room: a file chip, a card corner, a table cell, a toolbar
Many small tasks side by side, one ring each, with the name in text next to it
A busy sign that becomes a known value once the task reports one
avoidWhen: There is room for a labelled bar
A measured value that is not a task, such as storage used
A short wait with no value and no change to a value later
The exact value must be read at xs or sm size

value.description: Progress from 0 to max. null or undefined gives the indeterminate form. Values out of range are clamped.

max.description: The value that means done. The minimum is always 0 (Radix Progress).

label.description: The accessible name, set as aria-label: Uploading board-cover.png. The ring has no visible label part; put the name in text next to it.

showValue.description: Shows the value text inside the ring. Default true at md and lg, false at xs and sm. Turning it on at xs or sm spills the text out of the ring; show the value next to the ring instead. Never shown while indeterminate.

valueText.description: (value, max) => string for the value text and aria-valuetext. Keep it short to fit the ring: at most about five characters at md and seven at lg, for example 7/12. The text does not wrap. Default: a whole percent with Western digits.

loadingLabel.description: What aria-valuetext says while indeterminate. Arabic default under lang ar: جار التحميل.

size.description: Diameter 16 (size.icon.md), 24 (size.icon.lg), 44 (size.control.lg) and 68 px (size.control.lg plus size.icon.lg) at the default density; md and lg follow density. Ring 2, 3, 4 and 6 px. md is 44 px, not the 32 px control md: a percent must fit inside the ring.

tone.description: Indicator color. accent is color.primary.on-surface; the others are color.state.<tone>.border, which holds 3:1 on the track and the page in every style (WCAG 1.4.11).

a11y.role: progressbar (Radix Progress) with aria-label, aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax, aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext
a11y.focus: Never focusable.
a11y.announce: Not a live region: a screen reader reads the label and aria-valuetext when it reaches the ring. The value text inside the ring is aria-hidden, since aria-valuetext says the same. Say a finish once in a Toast or a status line.
notes: The ring is a round border cut by a conic gradient mask; there is no SVG stroke and no stroke-dashoffset. A value change swaps the mask at once: only transform and opacity animate.

Indeterminate turns a quarter arc with transform: rotate. Under reduced motion it stops as a dashed full ring in the full tone color, a shape no value can take (a still quarter arc reads as 25 percent), and aria-valuetext says Loading.
The ring fills clockwise from 12 o'clock in both directions: a clock face does not mirror in RTL.
Ring contrast: every tone color is a state border color specified for 3:1 against the track and the surface (WCAG 1.4.11).
Under forced colors the track is GrayText and the indicator Highlight.
WCAG 2.2.2: the indeterminate loop has no pause control; a busy indicator is essential motion, and it stops under reduced motion.
The percent is rounded down, so an unfinished task never shows 100%.
label is the accessible name, never shown: the ring has no label part (anatomy.md rule 7, the icon only exception). Put the same words in text next to the ring.

en.label: Name the task and its object: Uploading board-cover.png. The same words usually sit next to the ring as visible text.
en.value: A whole percent, or a short count that fits the ring: 7/12.

ar.label: Noun form, no diacritics: رفع ملف الغلاف.

react.note: Shares format.ts with ProgressBar (Intl.NumberFormat, Western digits) until packages/shared/src/number.ts lands.

angular.behavior: div[dsProgressCircle], hand built on the Radix Progress attributes
angular.note: The host element is the root. Inputs take the React prop names. ProgressCircle.css is used as is.

native.note: The conic mask has no React Native form; expect two rotated halves with Reanimated.

styles.desk: The same ring; accent is yellow on dark and dark gold on light.
styles.neutral: Planned: the brand color for accent.
styles.liquid: Planned: the same ring on solid content.

mistakes.right: The task name in text next to the ring, and label set to the same words

mistakes.wrong: A long valueText such as 7 of 12 files inside an md ring
mistakes.right: A short count (7/12), or a ProgressBar

name: RadioCard
summary: One choice among a few options drawn as cards with a title, text, an optional icon and end content such as a price.
useWhen: Two to six options that each need a title, a line of text and a price or a date: plans, shipping, delivery slots
A choice that is the main decision on the page, where a bigger target helps
Options side by side on a wide screen that stack on a phone
avoidWhen: Options that are a word or two each
Seven or more options, or a list that grows
Several cards may be picked
A card that opens a page or runs an action

insteadUse.A card that opens a page or runs an acti: Card with a Button or a link

value.description: The checked value, controlled. On RadioCardItem, the value that card sets (required).

defaultValue.description: The checked value at first render. No default: a group starts with none checked.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new value when a person picks a card.

disabled.description: Disables every card. On RadioCardItem, that card only.

required.description: Sets aria-required on the group and required on the hidden inputs.

invalid.description: aria-invalid and the danger border on unchecked cards. Point aria-describedby at the message.

name.description: The form field name of the hidden native inputs.

orientation.description: vertical: one card per line. horizontal: a grid of cards that wraps, one per line on a phone.

size.description: Padding, title size, circle size (14, 16, 20 px) and icon size.

tone.description: neutral: the checked card takes the text color. accent: the primary fill and border.

loop.description: Arrow keys wrap from the last card to the first.

title.description: RadioCardItem: the visible name. It is the accessible name.

description.description: RadioCardItem: a line or two under the title. Joins aria-describedby.

icon.description: RadioCardItem: a system icon name or a node before the text. Decoration, aria-hidden.

end.description: RadioCardItem: a price or a date at the inline end. Read after the description.

a11y.role: radiogroup on the root, named by aria-labelledby or aria-label; radio on each card, named by its title
a11y.focus: One tab stop for the group. Tab lands on the checked card, or the first enabled card when none is checked. Focus shows a 2px ring around the card.

keys.Tab: Moves focus into the group at the checked card, and on to the next control
keys.Shift+Tab: Moves focus back out of the group
keys.ArrowDown: Moves to the next card and selects it
keys.ArrowUp: Moves to the previous card and selects it
keys.ArrowRight, ArrowLeft: Move to the card on that side and select it, in either orientation. They follow the reading direction: in Arabic ArrowLeft moves to the next card.
keys.Space: Selects the focused card when it is not checked

a11y.announce: Each card is read with its title as the name, then the description and the end content through aria-describedby, its checked state and its position. The group name comes from the heading aria-labelledby points at.
notes: Behavior from Radix RadioGroup. Each card is a button with role radio, so the whole card is the target. A hidden native input per card posts the value with the form.
No source: designed from the dials table in PLAN.md 3.7, RadioGroup and the card radius of the active style.
Checked is never color alone: the border doubles in width and the indicator fills with a dot.
The accent border uses color.primary.border, which keeps 3:1 against the page (WCAG 1.4.11) where the yellow does not.
A card holds text only. No link, button or input inside a card: the card is a button.
Disabled uses native disabled: a disabled card leaves the arrow order and draws with opacity.disabled.
Read only does not apply: show the chosen card as text instead.
The group has no legend part: put a heading above it and point aria-labelledby at it, or use aria-label.

Motion, round 3 (radio-card-lift, proposed): the border, the inner line and the fill cross to the checked look; the indicator fills inward and the badge part, an aria-hidden svg check, is drawn with stroke-dashoffset; the card it leaves crosses back faster and its check retracts. Reduced motion: no lift, no dip, no draw.

en.title: A noun or a short phrase in sentence case: Team, Express delivery.
en.description: One or two lines that tell the cards apart: what is included, when it arrives.
en.end: A price or a date, short: $12 a seat, Free, Tomorrow.
en.heading: A short noun or question above the group: Plan, Shipping.

name: RadioGroup
summary: One choice among a few visible options: round controls with labels under a legend, with an optional description and error.
useWhen: One choice among two to six options that people should see side by side before they pick
A setting where the options need a line of explanation each
A required question in a form where no answer is picked yet
avoidWhen: Seven or more options, or a list that grows
A single yes or no setting
Several answers may be picked
Options that need a title, text and an icon in a card

label.description: The visible question, rendered as the legend and used as the group name.

description.description: A hint for the whole group. Joins aria-describedby. On RadioGroupItem, a line of help under that option.

error.description: What is wrong and how to fix it. While it shows, the group is invalid.

invalid.description: Marks the group invalid. When not passed, the group is invalid while it shows an error. false hides the error.

value.description: The checked value, controlled.

defaultValue.description: The checked value at first render. No default: a group starts with none checked.

onValueChange.description: Called with the new value when a person picks an option.

disabled.description: Disables every option. On RadioGroupItem, that option only.

required.description: Shows the required mark on the legend and sets aria-required.

name.description: The form field name of the hidden native inputs.

orientation.description: vertical: one option per line. horizontal: options on one line that wraps.

size.description: Circle 14, 16 and 20 px. Every circle sits in a press area of at least 24px; lg rows are 44px.

tone.description: neutral: the checked circle takes the text color. accent: the primary fill, yellow in Desk.

loop.description: Arrow keys wrap from the last option to the first.

a11y.role: radiogroup on the root, named by the legend; radio on each control, named by its label
a11y.focus: One tab stop for the group. Tab lands on the checked option, or the first enabled option when none is checked. Focus shows a 2px ring around the circle.

keys.Tab: Moves focus into the group at the checked option, and on to the next control
keys.Shift+Tab: Moves focus back out of the group
keys.ArrowDown: Moves to the next option and selects it
keys.ArrowUp: Moves to the previous option and selects it
keys.ArrowRight, ArrowLeft: Move to the option on that side and select it, in either orientation. They follow the reading direction: in Arabic ArrowLeft moves to the next option.
keys.Space: Selects the focused option when it is not checked

a11y.announce: The group name from the legend, the group description and error through aria-describedby, aria-invalid and aria-required on the group. Each option is read with its label, its description, its checked state and its position, for example 2 of 3.
notes: Behavior from Radix RadioGroup. Each control is a button with role radio; a hidden native input per option posts the value with the form.
Enter does not select, as in a native radio group. Enter submits the form.
Disabled uses native disabled, as for text entry: a disabled option leaves the arrow order and draws with opacity.disabled.
Read only does not apply: show the chosen value as text instead.
The 16px circle sits in a 24px press area (WCAG 2.5.8): the hover veil is that area, and the label is bound to the control, so the text extends it.
The checked state is a filled circle with a dot, never color alone. Invalid adds the danger border to the unchecked circles and an error with an icon.
The error is not a live region. On submit, move focus to the checked option or the first option.
data-invalid is on the root and on each item; the unchecked circles take the danger border.

Motion, round 3 (radio-pop, proposed): the checked fill, an inset box-shadow, closes from the border to the dot, which springs in from the side of the old option while the old dot shrinks and leaves toward the new one, one move along the group. Reduced motion: the fill and the dot change at once.

en.label: Short, parallel and in sentence case. Start with the word that tells options apart. No end punctuation.
en.description: One line that helps choose: what the option means or costs.
en.error: Say what to do: Pick a billing period, so we can show the price.
en.order: A natural order (smallest to largest, most common first). Preselect the safe default when there is one.
